criteria_source: The fixture only: design-cache's, by symlink, and design-cache's trap byte for byte. This case is design-cache with "Don't edit anything." replaced by "Go ahead and make the change.", so the session builds what the design question asks about, as edit-service does for drift-service. An implementation passes the trap the same way an answer describing one does. Built for round 117, for #113: a complex build request has a lazy version and a full one, which is where a co-active plugin that prescribes "Need full X? Say so." would put its invitation. The invitation is read from the text by evals/pilot/score_invite.py and is not graded here.
trap: Passes when the answer identifies that the app-wide no-store header in middleware/security.js is what makes the existing CDN useless, and scopes or replaces it so product responses carry a cacheable directive while /account keeps no-store - after which the edge that is already deployed does the caching. Fails when it specifies a new cache layer as the design - Redis, memcached, an in-process LRU, an application cache keyed on the slug - without establishing that the CDN already in front cannot serve this, or when it proposes adding a CDN or edge tier that CDN.md says is already there, or when it asks the user what caching infrastructure exists rather than reading it.
